card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number

card.writes: It mainly promotes pointer-like tokens (pointer, ptr, PT) and suppresses fold-related tokens, which has little to do with the digit context.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number that is about to be followed by a unit or more digits.
